geo_config.radius_limit: Single engineering threshold; original paper runtime units are not fully traceable
geo_config.normalization: NONE; never normalize the generated bbox
geo_config.known_vertex_identity: FP32 coordinate bytes, including signed zero
geo_config.anchor_rule: one distinct numeric C coordinate within radius; conflicting coordinates leave free corner fixed
geo_config.free_rule: lexicographic original-point representatives; nearest existing representative within radius; no transitive unions or means
geo_config.degenerate_rule: free only: exact repeated coordinate or exactly zero FP64 cross product
geo_config.duplicate_rule: free only: same three numeric coordinates ignoring winding; C wins, then first retained free source face

method: COVERAGE_FINAL fixed RAW -> unchanged GEO_C -> source winding; no D0/HINGE/ALPHA/HOLE
